description.value: A standalone forest cottage on the 20-acre Nectar Yoga Retreat property on Bowen Island, a 20-minute ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay. The cottage sleeps 1–2 guests and includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation. The retreat sits in a forested setting with alder groves and is part of a wellness-focused property that also includes a thermal sanctuary.

address.value: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Moonstone Cottage exists at Nectar Yoga Retreat, 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island. The cottages page explicitly lists Moonstone Cottage amenities including Wi-Fi, mini fridge, ensuite bathroom, and daily breakfast included. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or any cycling-related amenities anywhere on the site. The property is a yoga/wellness retreat on Bowen Island with a minimum 2-night stay requirement. Address and phone are confirmed from the about-us and contact footer (720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2; 604-947-6999).
